notes.subject: ka ntlheng ya monna wa yena
notes.rationale: בית אישה — 'ntlo ya monna wa yena' — 'ntlo' e šumišwa bjalo ka 'ka ntlheng ya' go bolela gore o ka fase ga balaodi ba monna wa yena

notes.subject: moya
notes.rationale: נפש — motho yo a pelo/mafiša a gagwe a sepelago, e sego 'moya' goba 'bophelo'

notes.subject: אסר
notes.rationale: kgomarollo — lentšu le raragilego leo le bolelgo sehlwehlelo sa go ikgomaretša; baatlhodi ba fapana: 'boitšoaro' kgatlhanong le 'kgomarollo'

translation: Gomme ge e le mosadi ka ntlheng ya monna wa yena, ge a ile a sehlwehlela goba a kgomaretša kgomarollo go moya wa yena ka laino,
